backups.recovery_title: How to recover on a new PC (manual)
backups.recovery_step1: Install Vaishnavi Store Manager on the PC (python main.py) and stop the app before the first login.
backups.recovery_step2: Copy the newest vaishnavi_<date>_<time>.db from the backup drive into the data folder and rename it to vaishnavi.db.
backups.recovery_step3: Delete any vaishnavi.db-wal / vaishnavi.db-shm files next to it — they belong to the old database.
backups.recovery_step4: Start the app: it recognises the backup, checks it, shows the backup time and asks you to re-enter the UPI / bank details.
backups.recovery_step5: Never copy vaishnavi.db while the app is running — always use the snapshots from the backups folder.
backups.confirm_body: Snapshot from {taken} (last invoice {invoice}). The live database (last invoice {live}) is saved as a pre-restore snapshot first.
backups.done: Restored. The application must restart now.
